name: Web Browser
description: Firefox-like browser that runs in the backend: a real Chromium loads the pages and the picture is streamed live into the dashboard. Images, JavaScript, logins, forms (POST), uploads and downloads work. Tabs, bookmarks toolbar and folders, history, find in page, zoom, home page and search engine. The session keeps running in the backend (closing or reloading the window loses nothing). Together with the VPN module, internal pages in the network of an agent open directly (Backend ↔ Agent link, no WireGuard needed on the server). Chromium is installed automatically when the module is enabled.
author: BYTERA
